messages:
tara: FYI ran ptq-int8 bringup for the new reranker v3 on the nightly holdout. overall NDCG@10 -2.1%, MRR -2.9% vs float. small but not uniform.

jon: any obvious slices?

tara: yes 5% of queries with literal escape sequences (backslashes, \u escapes, and some HTML escapes)

lee: hmm tokenizer drift? did tokenization or preprocessing change for v3?

tara: tokenization artifact appears only when our formatter template double-escapes preformatted text blocks. i dug a failing example: raw: `Path: C:\\Dev\\bin` -> formatted ends up with extra backslashes before tokenization.

jon: ptq can magnify boundary shifts around token IDs. near-tie documents flip.

lee: can we add a targeted slice in CI for patterns like `[\\\\\\\\u&<>]` and a tiny unit test that compares top1 float vs int8 for 6 handcrafted escape-heavy queries?

tara: good plan. also propose a safe formatter tweak: detect code-ish spans and skip html-escape for them (avoid changing user-visible behavior otherwise).

ci-bot: created issue #3598: "escape-slice + ptq top1 sanity" and kicked off extended holdout run : https://git.internal/r/3598

jon: short timeline: (1) add slice & unit tests (2) run tokenizer-locked ptq bench (3) try formatter revert in a canary and report per-slice deltas.

tara: PR incoming with repro cases and the test. will paste results when CI finishes. :thumbsup:
